model_findings: The current model extraction accurately captures the main cycle: context filtered agent profiles, iterative K-means threshold, normative prototype reuse or new-group creation, comparative fit and dispersion, salience=fit×accessibility, active-identity threshold, scenario decision module, optional outcome evaluation, and normalized accessibility updates.
Eq. 10 leaves accessibility update function unspecified; the note correctly discloses this and does not invent a universal additive update.

The two scenario descriptions broadly track the source. In the dictator game, €100 endowment, random receiver, 20% baseline, ± identity bias, N=50, 100 steps, 50 runs and accumulated wealth outcome are supported. Trash scenario setup/outcome summaries are consistent with source experiment.

claim_checks.claim: DIMA input, context projection, clustering, normative prototype matching/new-group memory, comparative fit and salience calculation.
claim_checks.result: PASS: definitions and equations align with Eqs. (1)–(9), Tables 1–5. In particular fit uses inter-group distance, in-group dispersion and out-group dispersion; salience is fit times accessibility; unknown groups are stored using cluster centroid and closeness-based initial accessibility.

PASS: Eq. (10) leaves the function unspecified and dependent on previous accessibility, salience and optional evaluated outcome; normalization across known group accessibilities is correctly retained. No universal additive update is invented.
